t: This augment can only be added to the $(l:modules/extruder_2)Extruder Module Mk2/$.$(p)When present, any fake blocks extruded by the module take on the properties of the faked block, e.g. $(item)Obsidian/$ is hard to break, $(item)Glowstone/$ emits light, and $(item)Redstone Blocks/$ emit a redstone signal.
此拓展仅可安装至$(l:modules/extruder_2)造桥模块 Mk2/$。$(p)安装后，模块所生成的伪装方块将继承对应真实方块的属性：例如$(item)黑曜石/$极难破坏，$(item)荧石/$会发出光源，而$(item)红石装饰方块/$则会输出红石信号。
